name: Galeb Duhr
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The printed trait block has no darkvision, Mold Earth, animated boulders, tremorsense or encounter-only charge damage.
For False Appearance, the one-minute setup requires concentration. Moving ends the disguise.
The Dash follow-up is an additional bonus-action option for a character already rolling. It cannot share the turn with the bonus action that starts the roll.

name: Gargoyle
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The v2 trait block grants 30-ft. walking, a choice of one ability increase, and immunity to poison damage. Its design notes instead discuss 25-ft. walking, both increases and a possible lesser poison defense.
The conversion has functional hands. The original fighter is unarmored to use natural armor and flight, and carries a longbow and arrows.

name: Gibbering Mouther
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The player trait block does not grant Aberrant Ground, darkvision or prone immunity even though its design notes discuss them.

The Gibber text uses each hearing creature rather than each other creature. The encounter includes the mouther itself if it can hear its own gibber. This is a table reading because the book omits an explicit self-targeting clause.
The character uses no spells, so form-appropriate somatic components and the prose under Playing a Gibbering Mouther do not affect this build.

name: Grell
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The player trait list grants a beak attack. It does not grant lightning resistance or a paralyzing tentacle attack. The lightning resistance appears in the design notes.
The character wears no armor. This avoids a ruling on what armor can fit a grell.

name: Grick
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, published through Dungeon Masters Guild and verified in the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The printed player traits are for Grick. Grick Alpha remains a separate encounter record.
Kamstra's Monks and Natural Weapons rule on p. 7 gives the Martial Arts bonus attack standard monk bludgeoning damage, even when the Attack action uses a stronger natural strike.
The source lists no language restriction beyond Common. Hermit adds Undercommon as its optional language. Slant does not use the background's tools.
